Title: Public Preview: JSON Schema support in Azure Event Hubs Schema Registry for Kafka applications

Body.Content: The Azure Event Hubs Schema Registry provides support for JSON Schema, allowing the utilization of the JSON Schema format when streaming data from Event Hubs using the Kafka API. Instead of directly sharing or managing the JSON schemas, users can leverage schema registry for event serialization and deserialization within their producer and consumer applications.
